name: mockymock-vscode
description: Run mockymock .cut COBOL test suites directly from VS Code.

mockymock.executablePath.description: Path to the mockymock executable. Leave empty to resolve 'mockymock' from PATH.

mockymock.copybookPaths.description: Folder paths passed as --copybook-path on every mockymock run, for resolving COPY / EXEC SQL INCLUDE members. Relative paths resolve against the .cut file's workspace folder. Resource-scoped so each folder in a multi-root workspace can set its own via that folder's .vscode/settings.json.

mockymock.lintOnSave.description: Run 'mockymock lint' (static checks only, no Docker) on open/save of a .cut file and show the problems as diagnostics.

mockymock.maxParallelRuns.description: How many .cut files may run concurrently in one test run. Each run compiles and executes inside the shared mockymock-cobc container; raise this only if your setup tolerates concurrent compiles.
